name: Futrumi
description: Futrumi is a Czech food-tip platform: named food critics, chefs, sommeliers, and gastronomy journalists share where they actually like to eat and drink, with the exact dish or drink they recommend. This MCP server exposes the published, curated data to AI assistants so users can ask things like "najdi mi vínárnu v Karlíně" or "co doporučuje Michal Daněk" and get real expert opinions, not generic web results. Each result includes the expert's quote in the original Czech, the business profile, and a deep link to the Futrumi mobile app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Futrumi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Futrumi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.futrumi.cz/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Futrumi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Futrumi provides these MCP tools: search_recommendations, find_recommendations_near, get_recommendation, get_business, get_expert, and list_experts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Futrumi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Futrumi in media on the Manufact MCP catalog include CardChain AI, FreqBlog Music Metadata, KinElo, QuizHP, and Wistia.
Futrumi does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Futrumi is developed by Fingerlicky, s.r.o.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
